Name: Aquarius Flat Bottomed Boat
Notes: Status: In service mostly in the Pangong Tso. Flat-bottomed boat made of fiberglass with a length of 35 ft (11 m). Capable of carrying 20–22 troops, and reaching a speed of 20 knots (37 km/h). Made by Aquarius Shipyard Pvt Ltd.

Name: GSL Fast Patrol Boat
Notes: Status: In service. Made by Goa Shipyard. Used for patrolling in Pangong Tso lake. The boats are specially equipped with anti-ramming features, optical sensors, weapon systems and other specialized surveillance gears.

Name: Tempest 35 Swat Patrol Craft
Notes: Status: In service. Used for patrolling in Pangong Tso lake. These high-speed interceptor boats are equipped with GPS, sonar, echo-sounder and infrared night-vision cameras. It can reach speeds up to 40 knots and carry 10 fully armed soldiers.
